form.title: Suggest an entry
form.lead: Sending this form does not publish a page. It reaches the catalog owner, who adds the entry by hand.
form.workTitleHint: Choose one from the list, or type your own.
form.characterHint: Required if you are suggesting a character.
form.sourceHint: The manhwa page, chapter, or post the details come from.
form.tagsHint: Comma-separated. For example: silver hair, grey eyes, knight.
form.emailHint: Only needed if you want a reply.
form.summary: Check the form. Some fields need attention.
form.netlifyNote: The suggestion is sent to the catalog owner.
form.formspreeNote: The suggestion is sent to the catalog owner.
form.web3formsNote: The suggestion is sent to the catalog owner.
form.web3formsMissing: Suggestions cannot be sent right now.
form.customNote: The suggestion is sent to the catalog owner.
form.thanksBody: If you left an email, a reply will come there. A character page appears in the catalog only after the owner adds it.
form.success: Suggestion sent. It will not publish a page by itself — the owner adds it to the catalog by hand.
form.error: Could not send. Check the fields or try again.
form.notConfigured: Suggestions cannot be sent right now.
form.rateLimit: Too many suggestions in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
form.turnstile: Confirm you are not a robot, then send again.

validation.url: Enter a full link starting with https://.

notFound.title: No page here
notFound.body: The link is out of date, or the address has a typo. The catalog is still here — go back to the characters or the home page.
